subject: Retirement of Paulette van de Kloot
overview: The committee celebrated the 32-year tenure of retiring member Paulette van de Kloot and received reports on rising kindergarten enrollment. Members also approved expanding COVID-19 testing to the Kids Corner program.

items.title: Consent Agenda
items.summary: Approved the consent agenda, including bills, payroll, and minutes from the December 6 meeting.

items.title: Special Education Subcommittee Minutes
items.summary: Tabled the Special Education subcommittee minutes from the December 16 meeting.

items.title: Superintendent's Report
items.summary: Superintendent Edouard-Vincent recognized fall athletic stars and shared the upcoming winter holiday schedule and cultural recognitions.

items.title: COVID-19 Update
items.summary: Assistant Superintendent Murphy discussed rising positivity trends and announced the launch of weekly vaccination clinics starting in January.

items.title: Kindergarten Enrollment Update
items.summary: Assistant Superintendent Guzzi reported an unexpected increase of 23 kindergarten students, noting that McGlynn Elementary has reached capacity and may require student reassignments.

items.title: Recognition of Paulette van de Kloot
items.summary: The committee and community members honored Paulette van de Kloot for 32 years of service with tributes from former superintendents, state officials, and the Massachusetts Association of School Committees.

items.title: Tabled Business and Condolences
items.summary: Tabled continued business to January 3 and noted the passing of former employee William J. Billy Finn.

items.title: Kids Corner COVID-19 Testing
items.summary: Approved the implementation of a weekly COVID-19 testing program for staff and children in the Kids Corner program.
